historical_reviews.deepseek: Readback can identify a configured value but cannot prove the required physical restore behavior; raw OEM mapping, target, credential handling and actual AC evidence are missing.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly separates protected readback from two high-impact physical scenarios and retains user-owned verdict and recovery.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The Criteria describe LastState behavior even though the title says default policy. The behavior oracle is nevertheless explicit: final power must equal the pre-loss state in both controlled scenarios; the approved platform default must also be recorded rather than guessed.

original_test_intent: Validate the platform's approved default AC-loss policy by both supported readback and actual restore behavior from powered-on and powered-off pre-loss states.
original_method: Verify the exact SUT/BMC/PDU and approved default semantics, preserve logs and workload state, collect protected IPMI/Redfish/UI readbacks, then under separate operator control remove and restore AC from an on state and an off state, measure final state and recovery, and restore the original baseline.
manual_activity: An operator confirms the outlet and maintenance window, performs each AC removal/reapplication, observes independent power/boot state and owns recovery and final verdict.
required_inputs: Approved default policy and firmware semantics
Expected result for on and off pre-loss states
safety_requirements: Do not interrupt an active production workload
Require human approval for each physical AC scenario
Verify the exact outlet before action
Use protected credentials and validated TLS
Do not infer behavior from readback alone
Stop on wrong target, unexpected state, alarm or recovery timeout
Preserve SEL, audit and OS logs
Restore baseline before closure and never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify same-target identity and supported policy mapping
Record PDU, BMC, power and boot timelines
Compare observed final states to the approved matrix
engineer_actions: Approve default-policy semantics and scenario matrix
Perform or supervise physical AC actions

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The reads are supporting evidence only; the OEM bytes are not vendor-mapped, credentials/TLS are unsafe and neither required AC scenario is executed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use supported protected policy readbacks, then record two separately approved manual PDU/AC scenarios with independent observers and bounded recovery; never automate cable handling or infer behavior.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 5/5-minute estimates and both source scenarios are retained, while blanket log clearing is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the configured policy and platform default to a two-row pre-loss/final-state matrix, with monotonic timestamps for AC loss, AC return, BMC readiness and host state, plus post-event health and baseline restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact outlet identity, workload safety, independent recovery and evidence boundaries around the source's physical actions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A policy string proves configuration, not controller persistence or real restore behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: PDU telemetry and BMC availability may recover before host boot; each milestone needs a distinct timeout and observer.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define the platform default and accepted LastState behavior. Any policy mutation belongs to the following explicit policy rows, not this default-policy observation row.
expected_evidence: Approved target/default/policy mapping and complete pre-test baseline
On-pre-loss AC timeline ending on after restore
Off-pre-loss AC timeline ending off after restore
PDU, BMC, SEL, audit, OS/filesystem/workload health and no-unintended-change evidence

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title leaves the default value unnamed, but Procedure and Criteria consistently require readback plus LastState-like behavior from two pre-loss states. The Project default is a required input rather than a contradictory Master branch.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Policy mapping, PDU control, backup, approval and recovery are normal execution prerequisites; the case blocks only if they remain unavailable after request or a safe outage cannot be established.

review_improvement: Prevents a safe-looking read-only query from replacing the two destructive physical behavior checks and provides explicit outage, recovery and evidence controls.
independent_technical_reasoning: AC-restore behavior is stateful across complete auxiliary-power loss. A displayed policy may be stale, mapped incorrectly or not honored after controller restart. Testing both pre-loss states distinguishes true LastState behavior from AlwaysOn/AlwaysOff, but only when outlet identity, power milestones and independent recovery are controlled.
